dev_guide.name: Rook
barks: Dust's up again.
You buying or looking?
Rook knows a man.

npc_c9_01.name: Elder Ines Halloran
barks: Sixty people, {name}. Sixty.
Indulge an old woman and walk, don't run.

npc_c9_02.name: Doc Aurel Pell
barks: Wash your hands before you come in here.
He walked a long way to die on my floor.

npc_c9_03.name: Tamsin Roe
barks: Rust it, the pump's sticking again.
Did you see him? Before?
The fridge says variance is unchanged. The fridge can bite me.

npc_c9_04.name: Bram Coyle
barks: Nobody touches the door.
She's eating her own spares. Don't ask me what happens after.

npc_c9_06.name: Elder Rosalind Teague
barks: Weld it. Weld the thing shut.
Continuity is a duty, not a comfort.

npc_c9_r1.name: Ola Marr
barks: Ninety years, and then a knock.
The algae don't care who knocks. Somebody has to feed them.
Was he… all right? Before, I mean.

npc_c9_r2.name: Jory Benn
barks: Bram says the seal's older than the door. How does that work?
If you go out there, bring back something that isn't algae.
My grandmother said the sky was blue. I never believed her.

npc_c9_r3.name: Sayer Quist
barks: Soup's at six. It's always at six.
Teague wants it welded. Teague wanted the last one welded too, and there wasn't a last one.
He had a photograph. Of you. I don't like it.

npc_c9_r4.name: Pim Oyelaran
barks: Tamsin says she's going out. She says that every year.
I counted the door bolts once. Forty-one.
MOTHER thanked us for our continuity. What does that even mean?

npc_sh_01.name: Sheriff Ada Vey
barks: Noted.
Water first. Everything else after.
If you're here to sell, Pike's east. If you're here to steal, I'm here.

npc_sh_02.name: Deputy Jonah Reese
barks: Sir. Ma'am. — Sorry.
Sheriff says keep moving, so I keep moving.
I read the whole pump manual once. Twice.

npc_sh_03.name: Mags Durrow
barks: Drink's on the house, love. Water isn't.
Teo would've known what to charge you.
Mind the floor, it's older than you.

npc_sh_04.name: Factor Ozias Pike
barks: As per the posted rates.
The Tollmen guarantee delivery. The road guarantees nothing.
Seed. Any seed, any price.

npc_sh_05.name: Sister Calla
barks: The sky keeps no books. Sit; let me see that.
Water's free here. Don't tell Mags.
Who sent the wound doesn't change how it's dressed.

npc_sh_06.name: Hollis Crane
barks: Pup. Spare a pull?
Kite day coming. I can smell it.
The boards said a lot of things, once.

npc_sh_08.name: Mender Yusra Hadid
barks: Hold still.
The work is the work. Who wears it is your business.
Don't touch that. It's charged.

npc_sh_09.name: Dov Reese
barks: She took my boy and gave him a badge. Badge won't stop a bullet.
Pumps run when they run.
Don't stand there, you're in the light.

npc_sh_10.name: Nell Durrow
barks: Aunt Mags says smile. I'm smiling.
The Wheel came through last month. Forty wagons. Forty.
If you want the room, ask her, not me.

npc_sh_11.name: Corporal Issa Lind
barks: Eyes up.
Jonah's a good kid. Kids die first.
When the Dogs come we fight. Ada knows it. Ada just hasn't said it.

npc_sh_12.name: Old Pardo
barks: The water comes when it comes.
Six, eleven, four, nine. Every day. Count it yourself.
Nobody asks the old man. The old man knows the clock.

npc_sh_13.name: Ruth Avel
barks: Letters go out with the next wagon. Pay in something a wagon wants.
Road's bad east. Road's worse west.
The Wheel owes nobody. The Wheel is owed by everyone.

npc_sh_14.name: Hesper Vale
barks: Two cups a day. Two. For a family.
You from the salt cut? Nobody's from the salt cut.
The Choir girl fixed my boy's arm for nothing. Nothing. I don't trust it.

npc_sh_15.name: Kit Doran
barks: Tribute's due. Everybody knows it, nobody says it.
I carried water for the Dogs once. Once.
Pike pays in Tolls. Mags pays in drink. Guess who I work for.

npc_sh_16.name: Benno Strand
barks: Militia. Volunteer. Mostly volunteer.
My cousin Ilya shot a bottle off a post at two hundred paces. Then he shot the post.
Keep the gun down in town.

npc_sh_17.name: Ilya Strand
barks: Right.
Wind's from the east. Means nothing. Means everything.
Two hundred paces. The post was the point.
Seven. Eight. Right.

npc_sh_20.name: Old Teodor
barks: Don't fuss.
Forty years of dust.

npc_sh_21.name: Pip
barks: It's fine. Calla did it.
I fell off the deck. That's all.

npc_sh_22.name: Abel Marsh
barks: Kit? The rope.
Sorry. Thought you were —

npc_rd_01.name: Kessler
barks: Fair.
Nobody drinks before the dogs do.
If you came to sell, Jack. If you came to talk, me. If you came to steal, Vasha.

npc_rd_02.name: Vasha Kade
barks: Say your name again. I like how it sounds when you're scared.
Kessler keeps lists. I keep count.
Shale's not a town. It's a well with people around it.

npc_rd_03.name: Wren Calloway
barks: Two riders, no dust. So they came from the wet.
Don't stand on the skyline. Everyone stands on the skyline.
The girl's fine. Don't ask about the girl.

npc_rd_05.name: Dog-mother Perpetua
barks: The dogs know you before I do.
Forty years of this camp in my head. Ask me anything; pay me in something.
Teo counts well for a man in a cage.

npc_rd_06.name: Brindle
barks: Hands where Wren can see them. She can see them from anywhere.
I'm sixteen. I've been a Dog nine years.
Don't go near the pens. They bite strangers first.

npc_rd_07.name: Sallow Jack
barks: Everything shoots. Nothing shoots straight. Pick.
Brass is money. Bring me brass.
Vasha wants a gun that shoots through walls. I told her: walls are the point.

npc_sh_07.name: Teo Marsh
barks: I can explain the numbers. Nobody wants the numbers explained.
Tell Mags I'm — tell her I'm fine.
Sixty Tolls. It was forty last week.

npc_rd_t1.name: Rust Dog (Fenn)
barks: Forty measures. Count them, I can't.
Vasha said don't smile. I'm not smiling.

npc_rd_t2.name: Rust Dog (Sorrel)
barks: Nice town. Shame about the water.
We walked. Somebody's going to pay for the walking.

npc_rd_t3.name: Rust Dog (Gant)
barks: Barrels on the cart. Move.
Gant. Don't.

npc_rd_t4.name: Rust Dog (Pell)
barks: First tithe. Wren said keep my mouth shut.
Is it true the sheriff hangs people?

npc_rd_g1.name: Rust Dog (Cass)
barks: Water's ours. Kessler says so.
Don't touch the tank.

npc_rd_g2.name: Rust Dog (Mole)
barks: Sit, if you're sitting.
Mole. Because I dig.

npc_rd_g3.name: Rust Dog (Tally)
barks: You from Shale? You smell like Shale.
Tribute's soon. Everyone gets a share.

npc_rd_g4.name: Rust Dog (Hob)
barks: Hob. Don't.
Kessler's soft. Don't tell him I said.

npc_rd_g5.name: Rust Dog (Sprat)
barks: I see everything from up here. Mostly dust.
Wren taught me. Wren's leaving. Don't tell.

npc_rd_g6.name: Rust Dog (Lute)
barks: Dogs eat first. Then Kessler. Then us.
Race day's when Perpetua says.

npc_th_01.name: Sergeant Halla Brecht
barks: Rates are posted.
Nobody argues with the wall. People argue with me, which is worse for them.
Pass or pay. Those are the words.

npc_th_02.name: Clerk Emmett Sayle
barks: Name, cargo, destination. In that order.
The ledger does not lie. People lie to the ledger.
Stamps are twenty. Arguments are free and change nothing.

npc_th_03.name: Quartermaster Dunya Rask
barks: Guild prices. Guild water. Guild everything.
If it's on the shelf it's for sale. If it's in the cage it's been sold.
No credit. The guild is credit.

npc_th_04.name: Cass Mohr
barks: Contracts don't have faces. That's what makes them contracts.
Four days out, three back. The road gets longer every year.
Don't touch the bike.

npc_th_05.name: Nikko Vance
barks: Cass does the talking. I do the other thing.
You hear the old man came all the way to the salt cut? On that leg?
I sleep fine. Ask anyone.

npc_th_06.name: Oren Tulley
barks: Thirty-one days. I keep the count; they keep the other one.
I fixed their pump. That's how I got here.
Don't stand too close. They count that too.

npc_th_07.name: Bettany Oduya
barks: Caravan leaves when the guild says and arrives when the road says.
Three days to Ninebridge if nothing happens. Something happens.
You can walk it. People do. Some of them twice.

npc_th_g1.name: Guild Guard
barks: Keep off the wall.
Lamp's on a timer. So am I.

npc_th_g2.name: Guild Guard
barks: Stamp?
East is that way. So is the toll.

npc_th_g3.name: Guild Guard
barks: Night rate's the same as the day rate.
Nothing moves on the wall at night but the lamp.

npc_th_g4.name: Guild Guard
barks: Stamp.
The guild thanks you for your custom.

npc_sg_01.name: Tally
barks: Copper's ours. Voice is nobody's.
You hear it at night, up there. Same words. Same order.
Don't go up with a light. It talks louder when there's a light.

npc_sg_02.name: Brick
barks: Track's closed.
Tally does the talking. I do the track.

npc_sg_03.name: Pim
barks: Forty metres of copper in that mast, Tally says. Tally says a lot.
I went in the station once. I don't go in now.

npc_dw_01.name: Oriel Marr
barks: Eleven o'clock. Listen. There.
My father said the pumps would outlive the town. He was a pump man. He was right.
Sit. The chair's the only thing here that was built for sitting.

npc_dw_02.name: Sable Marr
barks: Far enough.
Seven rounds. I count them so you don't have to.
Shale thinks the pressure drop is the city. Let them.

npc_dw_03.name: Juno Marr
barks: Beans. In a planter. In Dry Wells. Grandmother says that's a joke; I say it's beans.
If you're from Shale, don't tell them about the valve.

npc_dw_04.name: Cato Marr
barks: The valve's mine to turn. Grandmother says when, I say how far.
Cistern 4. Say it to anyone in Shale and watch them not know it.

npc_dw_05.name: Wick Marr
barks: I can hear the clock in the pumps. Sable says that's not a thing.
I've never seen Shale. I've seen its water go past under the floor.

npc_dw_06.name: Guild Engineer Osk
barks: By the measure.
Allocation is posted. Reliability is not negotiable.
The guild thanks you for your custom.

npc_w_outrider_a.name: Outrider Sorin Vale
barks: Papers.
The road is insured between posts. You are not between posts.
As per.

npc_w_outrider_b.name: Outrider Hesper Quayle
barks: Sorin does the talking.
Bike's running hot. Make it quick.

npc_w_drifter.name: Pell Amory
barks: Don't. Just don't.
It was a kite. Nobody believes the kite.

npc_w_scout_a.name: Rust Dog (Hale)
barks: Water. Then we'll see.
Kessler counts us when we come back. Kessler counts everything.

npc_w_scout_b.name: Rust Dog (Nettle)
barks: Hale talks. I count the rounds.
Shale's water tastes of the pipe.

npc_w_wheel.name: Ansel of the Wheel
barks: The Wheel turns; it doesn't stop for anyone.
Horses first. Then you.

npc_w_walker.name: A walker
barks: East. It said east.
I had a name. It's in the book now.

npc_w_carter.name: Carter Oswin Bell
barks: Axle. Of course it's the axle.
Guild delivery is guaranteed between posts. This is between posts.

npc_w_carter_guard.name: Caravan Guard
barks: Keep your hands where the wagon can see them.

npc_wp_01.name: Odd Marit
barks: Copper's mine. The rest is yours.
Six towers. I've had the wire out of four.
The Wheel pays in horseshoes. I don't have a horse.

npc_or_01.name: Brother Anselm Quade
barks: Twelve. Last year it was nine.
The sky is open. Everything under it is ours to mend.
They take the green ones. Who takes green ones?

npc_or_02.name: Novice Petra Lund
barks: Sister Calla says water the roots, not the leaves.
I heard them last night. Two. Small.

npc_or_03.name: Novice Dun Mercer
barks: I was a Dog till I was twelve. I know a Dog's footprint.
The well's forty feet and the bucket's thirty-nine.

npc_or_04.name: Kip
barks: Run.
Mote, run.

npc_or_05.name: Mote
barks: They're sour.
Kip said nobody'd miss them.

npc_wh_01.name: Sefa Oduya
barks: Guests eat first. Then we talk.
The Wheel turns on the fourth day. Be on it or be left.
Nobody owns a road. Some people collect for one.

npc_wh_02.name: Dario Oduya
barks: Shale has a well that never dries. I've seen it.
Mother says the road. The road says nothing back.
Another four days, another pan.

npc_wh_03.name: Mirren Kade
barks: Don't walk behind her. She's asked you nicely once.
Four horses. Last year, six.
A horse drinks what three people drink. Think about that before you ask the price.

npc_wh_04.name: Tulla Oduya
barks: Road prices. The road is long.
Guild scrip? Only if you're leaving it behind.
Everything on the blanket walked here. So did the price.

npc_nb_01.name: Grand Factor Imelda Sarr
barks: Not at that price.
Everything is for sale. The question is only when.
The market is kinder than a plan. A plan cannot be bargained with.

npc_nb_02.name: Auctioneer Fen
barks: Lot four. Do I hear sixty?
Cheerful voice, is the trick. Nobody buys from a mourner.
I hate it. I'm good at it. Those are different things.

npc_nb_03.name: Odile Marchetti
barks: Money is weather, my dear. You dress for it.
I sold a man his own funeral once. He haggled.
Everything is borrowed. That is not a complaint; it is a price.

npc_nb_04.name: Toll-warden Esk Varga
barks: Twelve to cross. Twelve back. The bridge doesn't care which way you're facing.
The porters can sit. The goods can't.
Guild deck past the sandbags. Mind the ninth.

npc_nb_05.name: Hadley Voss
barks: Forty backs. The guild has none.
They say we lose on the third day. They said it before we started.
Sit down. Straps off. That's the whole speech.

npc_nb_06.name: Clerk Amity Rook
barks: Paper is paper until it's signed. Then it's the future.
The ledgers close at nine. The ledgers never close.
Don't touch the board.

npc_nb_07.name: Captain Marlow Dent
barks: Guild deck. Weapons stay down.
The ninth span fell on its own. Everything since, somebody pushed.
Trouble on my bridge goes in the river.

npc_nb_08.name: Sable
barks: Don't look at me like a sum.
Sixty. I heard him. Sixty.
I had a sister once. Everyone had a sister once.

npc_nb_09.name: Marguerite Oyo
barks: Guns, cells, and things that were somebody's.
Guild price on the sign. Your price is on your face.
The Concern makes it; the Menders fit it; I just sell it.

npc_nb_10.name: Pim Haddow
barks: Water's guild water. Tastes of the bridge.
Fruit from Openfield, when the Choir sends it. They haven't.
Eat something. You look like a forecast.

npc_nb_11.name: Lazlo Brand
barks: The Span. Named for the one that's missing.
Bitters, water, Dust, a berth if you're clean.
Odile's tab is older than you.

npc_nb_g1.name: Guild Guard
barks: Toll's paid at the sandbags.
Keep walking.

npc_nb_g2.name: Guild Guard
barks: Floor's for ticket-holders.
No paper leaves the hall.

npc_nb_g3.name: Guild Guard
barks: East road's open. Mind the glass.
Block opens at nine.

npc_nb_g4.name: Guild Guard
barks: Back door's a door too.
Ticket, or walk round.

npc_of_01.name: Elder Mason
barks: The sky keeps no books.
Every third row. I have counted them so often the counting is a prayer.
Sit. Nobody here will ask you to sing.

npc_of_02.name: Petra Mason
barks: Don't paint me. Don't draw me. Don't remember my face if you can help it.
The sky is enough.
My father counts rows. I count other things.

npc_of_03.name: Brother Ash
barks: There's a weight to a thing like that.
Soil forgives. It's the only thing that does, so I work in it.
Friend.

npc_of_04.name: Tobias Mason
barks: Rows don't lie. People do.
My father thinks the sky is enough. The sky doesn't read.
Don't drink from the north trough.

npc_of_05.name: Sister Imre Dall
barks: Fever has a smell. This isn't it.
Boil the north trough. Boil everything.
Lie down. The sky can see you lying down.

npc_of_06.name: Keeper Doria Vance
barks: Counted at dusk, counted at dawn. The numbers walk at night.
Seed is the only thing we have that the glass can't grow.
A crate a night. Somebody is patient.

npc_of_07.name: Old Benedek
barks: Forty years in the glass. Thirty of them green.
I saw a light at the well. Lights at wells aren't good.
The young ones sing. We used to work.

npc_of_08.name: Hollin Brannock
barks: Came from the Sump. They gave me the yard. That's more than anyone gave me.
Don't look in my tent.
Seed's seed. It grows anywhere.

npc_of_09.name: Wyn
barks: I drank from the north one. It tasted of pennies.
Is the sky still up?

npc_of_10.name: Marta Keel
barks: My hands shake. Imre says it's not the fever.
Tobias brought me water. Kind of him.

npc_of_11.name: Corso Vail
barks: Harvest futures, paid in advance. The guild carries the risk.
The Choir doesn't sell. The Choir's children do.
Seed is just a future in a smaller box.

npc_sp_01.name: Grel
barks: The tunnel's ours. We dug it.
Scrip on the fourth day. The guild's never late with scrip. Only with everything else.
Hesk Tanner can have the east rim and the wind.

npc_sp_02.name: Hesk Tanner
barks: There's a door down there that never opened. I'd like to be the one who opens it.
Grel digs. We think.
The guild pays us to clear a tunnel. Nobody asked what's at the end of it.

npc_sp_03.name: Dace
barks: Fourth day. Scrip. Both rims. Don't ask me why both.
Factor Pike pays for a tunnel. I carry the paying.
I don't go down. Nobody from the guild goes down.

npc_sp_04.name: Nib
barks: I've been down. Further than them. Don't tell Grel.
The machine's a bench. It's a good bench.
There's writing down there. I can't read it. I can read the pictures.

npc_sp_g1.name: Grel's Man
barks: Nobody goes down. Grel's word.
Scrip day's the fourth.

npc_sp_g2.name: Tanner Watch
barks: Nobody goes down. Hesk's word.
The west rim cheats at Dust.

npc_sp_w1.name: Digger (Grel's)
barks: Forty feet of rubble a week. The guild counts the feet.

npc_sp_w2.name: Digger (Grel's)
barks: Hesk's lot took our lamp. We took their rope.

npc_sp_t1.name: Tanner
barks: Hesk says the door's the prize. Grel says the tunnel is. The guild says dig.

npc_sp_t2.name: Tanner
barks: Grel's lot took our rope. We took their lamp.

npc_md_01.name: Captain Idris Lowe
barks: The schedule holds.
Every eviction is lawful. I have checked.
Nobody in the Precinct goes hungry. Outside the wall is outside the law.

npc_md_nine.name: Assessor Nine
barks: The record suggests otherwise.
Clause 14, subsection 3: the drains are the city's first duty.
I do not think. The record suggests.

npc_md_12.name: Sergeant Ottoline Reyes
barks: Face to the lens. Then we talk.
Hearings are Tuesdays and Fridays. Today is neither. It is never either.
The line is the line.

npc_md_13.name: Clerk Ambrose Tull
barks: Name, origin, purpose. In that order. The lens does the rest.
I don't decide. The file decides.
Flagged means flagged.

npc_md_14.name: Dr Linnea Hast
barks: Licensed. It says so on the door, which is more than most doors can say.
Every patient is a line in the file. I write carefully.
Chrome? Not here. The Sink has people for that, and the Concern has the licences.

npc_md_15.name: Idra Kemp
barks: Licensed prices. The licence costs; so do the prices.
No guns over the counter. The wardens sell those, to themselves.
Tickets for everything. I sell those too.

npc_md_16.name: Old Sabel Quint
barks: Forty years a citizen. Never once hungry. Never once asked.
The Sink floods in spring. We get a notice about it.
My daughter went to the Ring. There's a notice about that too.

npc_md_17.name: Tess Marlow
barks: Third day. Tuesday, they said. It was Tuesday yesterday.
My face isn't on their machine. My boy's is; he was born inside.
The Ring burned Tuesday. That's why we're here.

npc_md_g1.name: Warden
barks: Inside the wall is inside the law.
Move along the avenue.

npc_md_g2.name: Warden
barks: Face to the lens.
The line is the line.

npc_md_g3.name: Warden
barks: Papers.
Curfew at nine.

npc_md_g4.name: Warden
barks: The schedule holds.
Water's point eight. Don't waste it.

npc_md_g5.name: Desk Warden
barks: Fines at the counter. Bail at the counter. Complaints, also at the counter.

npc_mk_01.name: Half-Price
barks: Half pays half. That's the name, and the deal.
The board's the board. I'm only the hatch.
Don't look under the hood; there's nothing there you'd like.

npc_mk_02.name: Auntie Wen
barks: Two Tolls a bowl. Three with meat. Don't ask which.
Everyone eats here. Everyone talks here. I hear it all and sell none of it.
Sit. You look like a forecast.

npc_mk_03.name: Dessa Kuhn
barks: Dark chrome. No leash, no licence, no warranty.
Boxed, not fitted. The Sink fits; I sell.
Concern chrome's prettier. Concern chrome phones home.

npc_mk_04.name: Harlan Galt
barks: Unlicensed. Everything in Old Market is; that's what the wardens count.
Guild ammunition, Mender pistols, one rifle I won't say where from.
Point it at the floor in here.

npc_mk_05.name: Sato
barks: No sign on the door. If you found it, you were sent.
Papers are paper. The lens is the problem, and the lens can be told things.
I don't do forecasts. I do the past.

npc_mk_06.name: Mirabel Tosh
barks: Paper. News, letters, the Precinct's notices a day late and half the price.
I don't sell futures. I sell what already happened; it's cheaper and truer.

npc_mk_07.name: Ferenc
barks: Sit. Tea's two. Talk's free and worth it.
The Crown's having a Masque. The Sink's having a flood. Same week; different notices.
There's a girl in Bridgeward who says true things in a dead radio's voice.

npc_mk_08.name: Lark
barks: It talks if you feed it. I feed it.
It said my name before I told it. Everyone's.
Don't pull the wire. The wire's how it knows.

npc_mk_09.name: Caddo Vell
barks: Point six. They say point eight and the dial says point six.
The Precinct drinks what we don't. Say it with me.
Forty people in this queue and two wardens. Count.

npc_mk_10.name: Pinch
barks: I buy anything that's not nailed down, and I know a man with a claw hammer.
No questions. I've a rule about questions; it's the only rule I've got.

npc_md_g6.name: Warden
barks: Count's at noon and six.
Unlicensed. All of it. Noted.

npc_md_g7.name: Warden
barks: East street's closed past the bulbs. Works.
Keep the aisles clear.

npc_sk_01.name: Ocho
barks: Sit. The queue sits.
Fit only what the patient can bear. The rest is vanity with a scar.
Free means free. Don't make me say it again.
Hold that. No — hold it like you mean it.

npc_sk_02.name: Pell
barks: Boiled. Everything's boiled. Don't touch the shelf.
He hasn't slept since the line went up. Don't tell him I said.
Apprentice. Two years. He says the hands come in the third.

npc_sk_03.name: Dagny Roos
barks: Three pumps. Two run. The schedule says which.
I keep them. I don't set them. Read the board.
Spring's a dial, down here. Somebody up there turns it.

npc_sk_04.name: Mother Lusk
barks: Name, year, where the water took them. That's all a wall needs.
The Precinct has a file. We have a wall. The wall's truer.
Chalk's a Toll. Names are free.

npc_sk_05.name: Vash
barks: Anything that was ever warm. Fair price. No questions, which is also a price.
Cold box is cold. That's the whole business.
Menders fit. I supply. Ask Ocho where he thinks the supply comes from.

npc_sk_06.name: Saskia Dray
barks: No chrome. Ever. We remember the Scald.
The pumps are ours by water. The Precinct has them by paper.
You've a face the water hasn't had yet. Keep it.

npc_sk_07.name: Tam Oduya
barks: It skips. Ocho says it skips.
Pumped for the Precinct eleven years. The wet got in.
Don't let him pay for it. He'll pay for it.

npc_sk_08.name: Jory Sand
barks: Raft takes two. Takes one and a box.
I pole the deep bit. Nobody walks the deep bit.
Found a car under the clinic once. Found who was in it.

npc_sk_09.name: Ailsa Penn
barks: Lungs. It's the wet. Everyone's is the wet.
My boy's on the wall. Third line down, spring before last.
Ocho gave me lungs that whistle. Better than lungs that don't.

npc_sk_10.name: Kye
barks: Run anything. Two Tolls. Not east.
Vash pays by the pound. I don't ask of what.
Pale took a man off the walk last week. Owed them. He walked back lighter.

npc_sk_p1.name: Pale Sworn
barks: Turn round.
Not east. Not you.

npc_sk_p2.name: Pale Sworn
barks: Walk ends here.
Chrome? Show me your hands.

npc_sk_p3.name: Pale Sworn
barks: The Scald took the chromed first. We remember.

npc_sk_w1.name: Warden
barks: Pump house is the city's. Keep walking.
Schedule's on the board. Read it from there.

npc_sk_w2.name: Warden
barks: Nobody inside without the keeper's say.
Relief's at point six. It says so.

npc_lr_01.name: Mab Corrigan
barks: Twenty on the undercard. Two to one. Chalk doesn't lie; I do, but not about chalk.
Thirty to enter. Ninety if you're standing. Nobody's standing.
Floor's washed. Mind it.

npc_lr_02.name: Anvil
barks: Hands and iron. I don't go for the head unless you do.
Nobody's standing since spring.
Bastien Roque. Anvil's what they shout.

npc_lr_03.name: Sunny Teague
barks: Second round. Watch his left; he doesn't.
I'm the small one. Bet on the small one.

npc_lr_04.name: Doubt
barks: They call me Doubt. Nobody's sure why.
Second round. Could go either way. Could.

npc_lr_05.name: Ysolde Marr
barks: Yours or better.
Don't buy one you can't put down. I mean it; I've seen the cots after.
The evidence shelf isn't for sale. Ask anyway; everyone does.

npc_lr_06.name: Pip Aldous
barks: Gilt. Say it like it's worth something.
Crown coin's counted. Row coin isn't. Guess which I carry.
East end's ours. Chain says works; chain means ours.

npc_lr_07.name: Dolour
barks: Dust. Ten the hand, thirty the high table.
The house wins. I am the house. Sit.
Fenwick lost a Crown chit at this table and cried. Crown kids cry beautifully.

npc_lr_08.name: Madame Oyelaran
barks: The Velvet. Company, conversation, the hour. In that order, if you're wise.
The Crown sends its girls to me to be dressed. I send them back dressed.
No chrome on the premises. Not for the Pale's reasons; for mine.

npc_lr_09.name: Fenwick Lorne
barks: Lorne. House Lorne. It used to mean something; it still means a chit.
I lost it at the hall. The chit. Mother will *see*.
Is this what the Row is? It's wonderful. It's horrible. Another.

npc_lr_10.name: Shay
barks: Boat's two. Bridge is free and further.
Canal's warm. Pumps. Don't ask me whose.
I've had the Crown in this boat. They tip in coin you can't spend.

npc_lr_11.name: Old Perrin
barks: Lit the first tube on this row. Pink. Still pink.
Every tube on the Row's mine. Every one that's dark is the Gilt's.
Canal was a street. I remember the street.

npc_lr_12.name: Kit Halloran
barks: Lost? I'm not. Two Tolls and you're not either.
Mind your purse. Not from me. From everyone.

npc_lr_g1.name: Gilt
barks: Crown coin's counted.
Chain says works.

npc_lr_g2.name: Gilt
barks: Pip says. That's the whole law.

npc_lr_h1.name: Pit Hand
barks: Floor's washed.
Bell in an hour.

npc_lr_h2.name: Pit Hand
barks: Guns with Mab. All of them.
Mind the gap.

npc_st_01.name: Hester Quill
barks: Committee meets when the committee meets. Sit.
Nine's dry, Twelve's pumping, and the Plan says the lifts run. Three things that are true.
9-14's empty. Key money's two-fifty. The Marrs left the kettle.

npc_st_02.name: Oskar Vey
barks: Tank fills at night off the Precinct main. What comes out after is politics.
I keep the valve. I don't set it. Everyone says that; I mean it.
Twelve pumps at two. Nine wakes at six to a dry bed. I've a log.

npc_st_03.name: Lio Brand
barks: Trays feed sixty. Dirt feeds nine. Do the sum.
Latch brings the nutrient. Latch takes a third. That's farming.
Nine can have the tank from six to two. We're not animals.

npc_st_04.name: Nessa Kord
barks: Pump's mine. Don't touch the pump.
Two to five. It's on the panel; it's not a secret, it's a schedule.
Nutrient's Concern-made. So's the pump. So, nearly, am I.

npc_st_05.name: Mama Deel
barks: Dirt remembers. Trays don't.
Tomatoes, the year the lifts stopped. Red ones. Ask anyone over fifty.
Beds are dry by noon. I water with a cup.

npc_st_06.name: Bo
barks: Nine floors in two minutes. Timed.
Twelve pays a Toll a message. Nine pays in bread. I like bread.
Ulla talks to the lift. The lift doesn't talk back. Mostly.

npc_st_07.name: Fitch
barks: Water. Tins. Wire. Everything a floor needs and nothing a floor wants.
Fitch has water. Don't ask whose.
Rent above twenty and you'll be buying from me daily.

npc_st_08.name: Ulla
barks: It counts. The lift. Every night at two it counts to forty and stops.
The Plan says the lifts run. The Plan says a lot.
Sit. The shaft's warm. The shaft's always been warm.

npc_st_09.name: Mr Latch
barks: A third of the crop. Nutrient and the pump. Fair.
The Concern believes in growth. So does a tray.
Nobody has to decide anything today. That's the Concern's whole offer.

npc_st_10.name: Ren Ashby
barks: One jerry-can of fuel. One night. Trays burn.
Mama Deel says talk. Mama Deel's been saying talk for three springs.
Latch wears a coat that never gets dirty. Think about that.

npc_st_t1.name: Twelves
barks: Trays. Mind the trays.

npc_st_t2.name: Twelves
barks: Deck's ours. Beds are theirs. Tank's whoever's awake.

npc_st_n1.name: Nines
barks: Water's for washing on Tuesdays. Says the committee.
Nine's dry.

npc_bw_01.name: Dagmar Holt
barks: Auntie Scrap, they call me. Not to my face. Say it to my face.
The bridge is ours because we're on it. That's the whole of law in Bridgeward.
Five to stand. Twenty to cross, if there were a crossing. There isn't. Five.

npc_bw_02.name: Corvo
barks: Boss's Hand. The hand does the lifting.
Tithe's a hundred, or a haul. Haul's honest.
The Gilt want the chain. The Gilt want a lot.

npc_bw_03.name: Petrov
barks: Anything with wheels. Anything that had wheels.
I cut cars. The Rustmouths cut me. That's the trade.
The Dogs left a buggy here once. I still have the seat.

npc_bw_04.name: Verity
barks: Listen. Under the hiss. It's always there.
The city talks to itself all night. We sit up for it.
A prophet is a radio that works. Nothing more; nothing less.

npc_bw_05.name: Immy
barks: — reserve nine, non-compliant —
— point six, as per —
— Thursday. Thursday. Thursday —
— a hand higher —

npc_bw_06.name: Tobin
barks: Three years listening. I heard my own name once. Nothing since.
She hears it in words. I hear it in weather.

npc_bw_07.name: Nell
barks: Hatch is ours. Stair's ours. The Sink's under it; that's ours too.
Show me your hands.
The bridge is nobody's. That's the only true thing said in Bridgeward.

npc_bw_08.name: Jax
barks: Chain says works. Chain means ours, as far as the fire barrel.
Pip says the bridge is next. Pip says.
Rustmouths charge the Crown's toll and keep the Crown's money. Somebody should tell the Crown.

npc_bw_09.name: Old Fenn
barks: Dogs had this garage. I was a Dog. I stayed; the garage stayed.
Kessler said the Sallow. Perpetua said the Sallow. I said my knees.
The cache is where it always was. Nobody's asked in nine years.

npc_bw_10.name: Ms Harrow
barks: The toll is the Crown's. The chain is the Rustmouths'. The arrangement is mine.
A bridge to nowhere still has a near end. The near end is worth something.
House Vane holds the paper on this bridge. I hold the pen.

npc_bw_11.name: Sadie Mott
barks: Five to stand on the bridge. Five to stand under it. Five to breathe, soon.
Carted for the Dogs once. They paid. Late, but they paid.

npc_bw_r1.name: Rustmouth
barks: Five.
Chain's shut.

npc_bw_r2.name: Rustmouth
barks: Five to stand.

npc_bw_r3.name: Rustmouth
barks: Haul's weighed Fridays.

npc_bw_g1.name: Gilt
barks: Chain says works.

npc_bw_s1.name: Listener
barks: Under the hiss.

npc_bw_p1.name: Pale Sworn
barks: Hands.

npc_cr_01.name: Celestine Vane
barks: The Chair, tonight. The file is not in doubt; only the room.
Smile. The lens is kinder to a smile.
My son is somewhere being unhappy at me. It is the season for it.

npc_cr_02.name: Honora Ashby-Crane
barks: Vane sells. That is all one needs to know about Vane.
A duel is a vote with the arithmetic shown.
My daughter is at the window again. The window is the only thing up here she likes.

npc_cr_03.name: Aurel Dace
barks: House Vane's door. Chit, name, or face.
Nobody has drawn on me in two seasons. It is a dull season.
The Row sends its bravo up in borrowed clothes. One can tell by the shoes.

npc_cr_04.name: Ottilie Ashby-Crane
barks: The window. You can see the canal from the window.
Osric is kind. That is the worst of it.
I paid. Did they tell you I paid?

npc_cr_05.name: Halden
barks: Sit. The light is good at this hour; the machine does not care.
Everyone wants to see what they become. Nobody wants to look at it afterwards.
No grain. That is how you tell. Real light has grain in it.

npc_cr_06.name: Marguerite Lorne
barks: I see everything from up here. It is what up here is for.
My son is at the Row, feeling something. I can see the Row from this chair.
Tea. Sit. Everyone sits eventually.

npc_cr_07.name: Steward Pell
barks: The house's steward. The house's hands, when the house would rather not look.
A cup, at the toast. Nobody up here asks what was in a cup.

npc_cr_08.name: Sergeant Ambrose
barks: Face to the lens. The lens decides; I only say it aloud.
Chit, pass, or standing. The help goes round the back.
Nobody forces the Crown. It has been tried. The lens remembers them.

npc_cr_09.name: Nan Brisk
barks: Forty covers. Move.
The back stair's mine. Nobody goes up it I haven't fed.
They don't look at the help. That's the help's one advantage.

npc_cr_10.name: Osric Vane
barks: Mother sold the Chair before she had it. I was in the room.
Tillie looks at the window. I look at the lift.
Everyone up here is being filed, and smiling for it.

npc_cr_11.name: Mr Quill
barks: The Concern does not usually attend. This season warranted it.
Futures are the only thing the Crown still makes. We buy what is made.
Nobody has to decide anything tonight. The Chair will.

npc_cr_12.name: Cutter Mabe
barks: Borrowed shoes. Pinch like a debt.
Honora pays by the bout. Up here they pay by the season.
Dace has never been hit by anyone who meant it.

npc_cr_w1.name: Lift Warden
barks: Face to the lens.
The help goes round.

npc_cr_w2.name: Lift Warden
barks: Chit, pass or standing.

npc_cr_hg1.name: House Guard
barks: Vane's door. Dace decides.

npc_cr_hg2.name: House Guard
barks: Back door's staff. Staff is Brisk's.

npc_cr_hg3.name: House Guard
barks: Ashby-Crane's. The old crest.
